title: Parity
summary: PAR'ITY, noun [Latin par, equal. See Pair and Peer.] 1. Equality; as parity of reason. 2. Equality; like state or degree; as a parity of orders or persons.

inlines.v: PAR'ITY, noun [Latin par, equal. See Pair and Peer.] 1. Equality; as parity of reason. 2. Equality; like state or degree; as a parity of orders or persons.
